'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Eastern front of the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Eastern Ukraine offensive]]
****[[Governor of Donetsk Oblast]] [[Pavlo Kyrylenko]] says that nine people have been killed by [[Russian Armed Forces|Russia]]n shelling in [[Donetsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/three-civilians-killed-russian-shelling-vuhledar-east-ukraine-presidents-office-2022-05-03/ (Reuters)]

****[[President of Russia|Russian President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] tells [[President of France|French President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] that his country is ready to continue peace negotiations with [[Ukraine]] amidst fears that talks between the two countries have stalled. [https://tass.com/politics/1446477/amp (TASS)] [https://www.thedenverchannel.com/news/national/putin-russia-ready-for-talks-with-ukraine?_amp=true (KMGH-TV)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2022 Russian debt default]]
***[[Russia]] avoids [[default (finance)|default]] on the [[US dollar|dollar]]-denominated bonds that were due in April by sending dollars to foreign investors just before the [[grace period]] expired. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2022-05-03/russia-poised-to-dodge-default-as-clearinghouse-processes-funds?srnd=premium-europe (Bloomberg)]
**[[International sanctions during the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[President of Russia|President]] [[Vladimir Putin]] signs a decree that will allow the [[Russian government]] to terminate any business and exports with entities and people that it deems "unfriendly". [https://www.reuters.com/world/putin-signs-decree-new-retaliatory-sanctions-against-west-kremlin-2022-05-03/ (Reuters)]
*Based on its preliminary findings, the [[European Commission]] accuses [[Apple Inc.|Apple]] of violating the [[European Union competition law|EU's competition law]] by blocking its competitors from accessing the technology used for the [[Apple Pay]] service, and threatens to fine the company up to 10% of its global revenue. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-61300874 (BBC News)]
*American bank [[Citigroup]] says that the [[flash crash]] that affected several European stock markets yesterday was caused by an error from one of its traders. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-61303217 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Changsha building collapse]]
**Two people are confirmed to have been killed when a building in [[Changsha]], [[China]], [[structural integrity and failure|collapsed]] on April 29. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-61309874 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Abortion in the United States]]
**''[[Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization]]''
***[[2022 abortion protests in the United States]]
****[[political demonstration|Demonstrations]] are held outside the [[United States Supreme Court Building|U.S. Supreme Court Building]] in response to last night's leak of the draft opinion. [https://www.politico.com/news/2022/05/03/protesters-supreme-court-abortion-opinion-00029583 (''Politico'')]
****In [[California]], an [[anti-abortion]] activist is detained by the [[San Francisco Police Department]] after climbing to the top of the 61-story [[Salesforce Tower]]. [https://www.kron4.com/news/man-climbing-sfs-salesforce-tower/amp/ (KRON-TV)] [https://www.sfgate.com/bayarea/amp/Man-climbs-SF-Salesforce-Tower-17144693.php (''San Francisco Chronicle'')]
***The [[Supreme Court of the United States|U.S. Supreme Court]] confirms the authenticity of the draft [[Judicial opinion|opinion]] indicating that the court would overturn ''[[Roe v. Wade]]'' and ''[[Planned Parenthood v. Casey]]''. [[Chief Justice of the United States|Chief Justice]] [[John Roberts]] condemns the leak and says that an investigation into the leak will be launched. [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2022/05/03/us/roe-wade-abortion-supreme-court#leaked-draft-of-supreme-court-ruling-signals-a-seismic-shift-in-american-politics-and-law (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/us-supreme-court-launches-probe-into-leak-draft-abortion-opinion-2022-05-03/ (Reuters)]
**[[Abortion in Oklahoma]]
***[[Governor of Oklahoma|Governor]] [[Kevin Stitt]] signs a [[heartbeat bill]], i.e. a bill banning [[abortion]] after a [[Cardiac cycle|heartbeat]] in a fetus is detected, which is at the age of about 6 weeks (except in cases of medical emergencies) and also adopts [[Texas Heartbeat Act|Texas-style enforcement]] to pursue offenders. The bill takes effect immediately. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/05/03/politics/oklahoma-heartbeat-act-abortion-governor-stitt-signs/index.html (CNN)]
*Carlos Guillén Tatis, the agriculture counselor at the [[Dominican Republic]]'s embassy in [[Haiti]], is [[kidnap]]ped in [[Croix-des-Bouquets]], [[Haiti]]. [https://apnews.com/article/latin-america-caribbean-haiti-dominican-republic-03d648e31f3fc08479e6cb8d199977de (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[European Parliament constituency]]
**The [[European Parliament]] votes in favour of an election law overhaul, to be confirmed and possibly amended by the [[European Council]], that will create a 28-seat pan-[[EU]] constituency and introduce elections of the [[President of the European Commission]] by popular vote. The reform will also create the European Electoral Authority, introduce [[postal voting]] for all EU residents, lower the minimum age of candidates to 18 and fix elections on [[Europe Day]], May 9. [https://www.euractiv.com/section/elections/news/european-parliament-agrees-position-on-eu-election-law-overhaul/ (Euractiv)]
